findings.title: [P2] Preserve explicitly empty names
findings.body: When `profile.name` is empty or whitespace-only, `trim()` produces `""`. The new `||` fallback changes the established result from that empty string to `"Anonymous"`, contrary to the stated contract-preservation goal. Retain a nullish check if empty names must remain distinct from missing names.

findings.title: [P2] Preserve empty trimmed names instead of replacing them with `"Anonymous"`
findings.body:
For `{ name: "" }` or whitespace-only names, `trim()` returns `""`. The previous nullish fallback preserved that value, while `||` converts it to `"Anonymous"`, breaking callers or tests that distinguish an explicitly empty name from a missing name.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
